name: ops
description: Ship it and run it. ship-gate audits a codebase before production against a pre-launch checklist and calls security:security-sweep for its security section. Instrument code (structured logs, RED metrics, OpenTelemetry, alerts with runbooks); define SLOs with burn-rate alerts; run feature flags as a lifecycle; design chaos experiments; plan zero-downtime migrations; design CI/CD and GitHub Actions; Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform patterns; dependency and Dependabot triage; changelogs from Conventional Commits; blameless postmortems; and wizards for steps only a human can do. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.
